title.narrative: Provide lifesaving Humanitarian response through a multi-sectoral approach in Limu woredas of East Wolega zone, Oromiya regional state.

description.narrative: ltpgtGerman Leprosy and TB Relief Association (GLRA) will implement a 12-month project by focusing on improving access and coverage of quality lifesaving Humanitarian response through a multi-sectoral approach in the existing government structure to deliver health and nutritionnbsp service, Multipurpose cash (MPC),) and providing psychosocial support in Limu Woreda. The project will strengthen the capacity of government routine Health service delivery, Acute malnutrition prevention and treatment, and build the knowledge of healthcare providers on the delivery of maternal health, and child health including Immunization, mental health, and psychosocial to ensure the continuity and sustainability of these vital services. The project will provide support on safe delivery, Antenatal Care (ANC), Post Natal Care (PNC), and under 5 children illness treatment including Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) cases, provide training for health care workers, health extension workers, and community nutrition volunteers on CMAM, maternal health , Mental health and IMNCI. The project will further provide MPC, distribution of Long-lasting insecticide-treated bed nets (LLIN), Strengthen the capacity of the Mobile health and nutrition team (MHNT), strengthen the Data collection/surveillance, rehabilitate and repair health facilities, Hygiene kit distribution, psychosocial support and counseling services and promote Maternal and Young Child Nutrition (MICYN). The planned project will reach a total of 17,187 people in the targeted woreda IDP returnee and host communities.nbsp In the course of its execution, the project shall integrate gender-responsive messaging and child safeguarding in its community engagement processes, share information, encourage discussions, and address gender and safeguarding issues that impact maternal and child health. ltbrgtThe project will also provide technical logistical support and strengthen the supportive supervision and monitoring system of Health and Nutrition services to the targeted health facilities, and community in IDP Returnees. The project will focus on supporting the most vulnerable population groups, specifically children, pregnant and Lactating women, mothers return IDPs, People living with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups. GLRA Ethiopia will integrate return IDPs and relocated health and Nutrition services into existing health services in each hospital, health center, health posts, and in the woreda health system using Primary Health Care and hospital staff and activating the woreda disease surveillance and monitoring as well as coordination in targeted woreda.ltbrgtAt project start-up, GLRA Ethiopia will prioritize return IDPs and vulnerable host communities by facilitating access to integrated life-saving health and nutrition services in collaboration with local government offices and other nutrition health implementing partners in targeted woreda. The health and nutrition activities will integrate and complement each other through under 5 sick clinics, MCH clinics (ANC, PNC, Delivery), referral, MIYCN, screening, and community behavioral change activities. GLRA will strengthen the capacity of the government health care providers, health extension workers, and community volunteers in Return for IDPs and vulnerable host communities to reduce morbidity and mortality of Maternal and children. The project will strengthen accountability to beneficiaries through the establishment and strengthening of an inclusive and appropriate community and facility-based complaints and feedback mechanism that will allow women, girls, men, and boys to safely report concerns about the health and nutrition response in their kebeles and woreda The project also will ensure gender-sensitive monitoring and evaluation is undertaken by disaggregating all data by sex, age, and disability and creating complementary qualitative and quantitative indicators. ltbrgtThe project beneficiaries were calculated as per the needs of targeted woredas.nbsp ltbrgtlt/pgt
